productPositioning.headline: Your Markdown Workspace — Built into Your Browser
productPositioning.elevatorPitch: SERP Notes is a browser extension that gives you a full markdown note-taking workspace right in your browser's side panel. Write in markdown, organize with folders and tags, search instantly, and sync across devices. A built-in AI assistant (Serpy) can draft, summarize, expand, rewrite, or generate notes from natural language instructions, and voice transcription lets you dictate hands-free. Share any note as a live link — or export to Markdown, Word, HTML, PDF, or plain text.
productPositioning.valueProposition: A complete note-taking workspace that lives in your browser sidebar. No app switching, no tab clutter, no SaaS logins. Write markdown alongside any web page, capture selections with a right-click, snip screenshots into your notes, and let AI help you write. Cloud sync keeps everything available across devices, and offline-first storage means your notes are always accessible.
productPositioning.targetAudience: Researchers, students, developers, content writers, knowledge workers, and anyone who takes notes while browsing the web. Ideal for people who want a distraction-free writing tool that stays beside their browser content.

storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP Notes is a markdown note-taking workspace built into your browser. Open it in the side panel with Ctrl+Shift+Y and start writing alongside any web page.

How it works: Click the extension icon or press Ctrl+Shift+Y to open the workspace in the browser side panel. Create notes in markdown with a full formatting toolbar — headings, bold, italic, lists, checkboxes, code blocks, links, and images. Organize notes into folders, add tags, pin important items, and search across everything instantly.

SERP Notes is offline-first. All notes are stored locally on your device and sync to the cloud when you are online. Your workspace is always available, even without an internet connection.

AI-powered writing: Serpy, the built-in AI assistant, can help you draft, summarize, expand, rewrite, or generate notes from natural language instructions. Enable web context capture to let Serpy read the current page and create structured notes from its content.

Voice transcription: Press and hold the microphone button to record, then release to transcribe. Serpy converts your speech into text and inserts it directly into your note.

Live sharing: Share any note as a public live link. Recipients always see the latest version, or freeze a snapshot to share a specific point in time.

Key features:
- Full markdown editor with formatting toolbar
- Browser side panel — write notes alongside any web page
- Serpy AI assistant — draft, summarize, expand, rewrite notes
- Voice transcription — dictate notes hands-free
- Web context capture — create AI notes from any web page
- Cloud sync — access notes across devices
- Offline-first — always available without internet
- Folders, tags, and pinning for organization
- Full-text search with page-aware filtering
- Wiki links ([[note title]]) with backlinks
- Command palette and slash commands
- Right-click to capture selected text as a note
- Screenshot snipping — capture screen regions into notes
- Live sharing with public links
- Export to Markdown, Plain Text, Word, HTML, or PDF
- Import/export JSON workspace backups
- Stats dashboard — total notes, word count, images
- Dark-themed professional interface

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Press Ctrl+Shift+Y or click the icon to open the side panel
3. Start writing in markdown — your notes save automatically
4. Use Serpy to help write, or dictate with the mic button

Sign in with your email to get started. Works on Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, and more.

faq.question: How do I open the notes workspace?
faq.answer: Press Ctrl+Shift+Y to open the side panel, or click the SERP Notes icon in your browser toolbar. The full workspace opens alongside your current page.

faq.question: Can I use this alongside any website?
faq.answer: Yes. The side panel works on any page. You can also right-click selected text on any page to save it as a note.

faq.question: Where are my notes stored?
faq.answer: Notes are stored locally in your browser first (offline-first). When you are online, they sync to the cloud so you can access them across devices.

faq.question: What is Serpy?
faq.answer: Serpy is the built-in AI assistant. Type a natural language instruction (like 'summarize this,' 'make this more concise,' or 'create meeting notes') and Serpy will edit or generate content in your note.

faq.question: How does voice transcription work?
faq.answer: Click and hold the microphone button in the Serpy bar. Speak your note, then release. Serpy transcribes the audio and inserts the text into your note. Maximum recording is 25 seconds.

faq.question: Can I share a note with someone?
faq.answer: Yes. Click 'Share live' in the note footer. This generates a public link at notes.serp.co that shows the latest version of your note. You can also create a frozen snapshot.

faq.question: What export formats are supported?
faq.answer: Markdown (.md), Plain Text (.txt), Word (.docx), HTML (.html), and PDF (.pdf). You can also export your entire workspace as a JSON backup.

faq.question: Does this work offline?
faq.answer: Yes. SERP Notes is offline-first. All notes are saved locally and sync to the cloud when connectivity returns. The editor, search, and export features all work without internet.

faq.question: What are wiki links?
faq.answer: Type [[ followed by a note title to create a link between notes. The backlinks panel shows which notes link to the current one.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Opera are fully supported. Firefox support depends on side panel API availability.
